entry.title: chore(deny): upgrade zstd-sys to 2.1.2, ignore zstd advisories blocke…
entry.content:
chore(deny): upgrade zstd-sys to 2.1.2, ignore zstd advisories blocked by provekit (#1146)

- zstd-sys 2.0.16 -> 2.1.2 (RUSTSEC-2026-0410, wasm32 allocator shim)
  Fixes the advisory cargo-deny reported; zstd-safe ^2.0.15 permits 2.1.x.
- Ignore RUSTSEC-2026-0391/-0398/-0403 (zstd 0.13.3 / zstd-safe 7.2.4):
  transitive via pinned provekit-common 1.0.2 which requires zstd ^0.13;
  the fixes live in zstd 0.14.3 / zstd-safe 8.2.0, unreachable until
  provekit-common ships on zstd 0.14.
- cargo also re-resolves tempfile's getrandom to 0.4.1 (allowed by
  tempfile's >=0.3,<0.5 req; dedupes with the workspace getrandom 0.4).

crypto-bigint/ctutils/tokio advisories were already fixed on main in

Amp-Thread-ID: https://ampcode.com/threads/T-01a17d3d-215c-71a1-94aa-50a7f441321d

#1137; this branch is rebased on that state.
